title: General Frequently Asked Questions
description: Official KNEC helpline and portal access details.

faqs.question: How do I log into the KNEC QMIS portal?
faqs.answer: Visit https://qmis.knec.ac.ke to access services such as confirmation of results and candidate queries.

faqs.question: What is the official KNEC helpline?
faqs.answer: You can reach KNEC support via official channels listed on https://www.knec.ac.ke.
